Hi Ava — quick commercial context from our side:

- Capacity recommendation: Rishi's note assumes the reserved pool covers steady-state and predictable burst patterns; batch windows are handled via burst capacity (not additive) unless you want dedicated reserved for batch. We can model both.

Hi team — following up with the sizing notes. Key points:
- Baseline: GreenWave steady-state averages ~250 input requests/min with median sequence length ~120 tokens.
- Peak: historical spikes up to ~1,200 RPS equivalent during scheduled scoring windows.
- Recommendation: reserve capacity sized for ~600 req/min (about 2.4x baseline) and enable burst capacity for scheduled end-of-month windows. This avoids paying for full-time 1.2k capacity while protecting latencies.
- Migration notes: warm KV cache prior to scheduled batch windows; we'll provide a warm-up script and a one-week runbook.

Attaching: RW_capacity_sizing_v2.pdf (diagram + numbers).

— Rishi
